title: Zesty Malaysian Haggis Satay
description: A savory and light Malaysian dish featuring haggis, tempering chocolate, and halal-friendly ingredients, with a glassy jelly texture. This dish is perfect for adventurous eaters looking to try something new.

ingredients.name: haggis
ingredients.notes: traditional Scottish dish made from sheep's heart, liver, and lungs

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Soak the bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Thread the haggis onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the haggis is cooked through.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Mix the coconut milk, satay sauce, lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves in a saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes, or until it has thickened slightly.
Serve the grilled haggis skewers with the satay sauce and melted tempering chocolate.
